title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version keeps the curated reader-facing working surface and adds the compact RA27 source-critical symbol-audit package after RA25 and RA26.

Current reader files. The main cumulative readers and standalone English paper PDFs remain the reader-facing surface. RA25, RA26, and RA27 are correction/audit tranches for the German/source branch of Paper 02, not full multilingual propagation packages.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. The files are useful working drafts and translation drafts; subtle formula errors, scan-reading errors, apparatus drift, and cross-language synchronization errors may remain. Verify important equations, tables, theorem statements, and unusual notation against the source witnesses before citation-critical use.

Latest correction packages. RA25 covers Paper 02 printed pp.71-75 and p.76 through formula (27). RA26 continues through printed p79 and p80 top before section 23. RA27 covers Paper 02 printed pp.80-83 through section 24; section 25 begins at the bottom of p83 and remains open. The table plates remain open.

Known open items. Next target is Paper 02 section 25 starting at p83 bottom / p84 onward, then pp84-90 and table plates. RA12-RA27 German corrections remain queued for EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH propagation. Full symbol-level source audit remains open beyond Paper 01 and the current Paper 02 tranches.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
